note: Enhanced PR Freelance pipeline scrape. 7-day window. Web-search sourcing only (no LinkedIn bot scraping). Deduped against pr-freelance reports 2026-05-25 through 2026-06-04. Quality-over-quantity: 6 leads (0 A, 5 B, 1 C). All leads score >=55. This run skews toward investor-relations / corporate-comms firms (The Equity Group, KCSA, Darrow) that regularly buy white-label / overflow execution, plus two live fractional-comms postings on vetted platforms (GoFractional, Daybook) and two boutique B2B/fintech PR agencies (Salient, Ditto). employmentTypeRaw vs engagementModel tracked separately: the IR/agency firms are firm-level overflow relationships (engagementModel reflects the realistic freelance/consultant pitch, not a single live FT posting); the two platform postings are explicitly fractional/contract. Note: aggregator landing pages (Upwork, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, FlexJobs) were screened out in favor of named buyers Mark can actually pitch.
